package httpapi

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/dronm/ds/v4"
	"github.com/dronm/webapp"

	"example.com/project/internal/services"
)

type collectionRows struct {
	ds.Rows
	values [][]any
	index  int
}

func (r *collectionRows) Next() bool { r.index++; return r.index <= len(r.values) }
func (r *collectionRows) Scan(destinations ...any) error {
	for index, value := range r.values[r.index-1] {
		reflect.ValueOf(destinations[index]).Elem().Set(reflect.ValueOf(value))
	}
	return nil
}
func (*collectionRows) Err() error   { return nil }
func (*collectionRows) Close() error { return nil }

type collectionConn struct {
	ds.Conn
	t            *testing.T
	continuation bool
	offset       bool
	queries      int
}

// Validate the SQL and bound values emitted by the real helper before
// returning database rows. A dropped where, flattened OR, wrong binder or
// mismatched method type fails this test before any second chunk can succeed.
func (c *collectionConn) Query(_ context.Context, sql string, args ...any) (ds.Rows, error) {
	c.queries++
	if c.continuation {
		for _, fragment := range []string{"priority < $1", "priority = $2", "item_code < $3", " OR ", " AND "} {
			if !strings.Contains(sql, fragment) {
				c.t.Fatalf("continuation boundary missing %q: %s", fragment, sql)
			}
		}
		if fmt.Sprintf("%v", args) != "[20 20 4]" {
			c.t.Fatalf("continuation arguments: %#v", args)
		}
	} else if strings.Contains(sql, " WHERE ") || len(args) != 0 {
		c.t.Fatalf("unexpected boundary in ordinary paginated request: %s %#v", sql, args)
	}
	if strings.Contains(sql, "count(*)") {
		count := 5
		if c.continuation {
			count = 3
		}
		return &collectionRows{values: [][]any{{count}}}, nil
	}
	if !strings.Contains(sql, "ORDER BY priority DESC, item_code DESC") || !strings.HasSuffix(sql, " LIMIT 2") {
		c.t.Fatal("sort/count contract changed:", sql)
	}
	if strings.Contains(sql, " OFFSET 1") != c.offset {
		c.t.Fatal("from contract changed:", sql)
	}
	values := [][]any{{5, 20}, {4, 20}}
	if c.continuation {
		values = [][]any{{3, 20}, {2, 10}}
	}
	if c.offset {
		values = [][]any{{4, 20}, {3, 20}}
	}
	return &collectionRows{values: values}, nil
}

type collectionPool struct{ connection *collectionConn }

func (p collectionPool) Conn() ds.Conn { return p.connection }
func (collectionPool) Release()        {}

type collectionProvider struct {
	ds.Provider
	connection *collectionConn
}

func (p collectionProvider) GetSecondary(context.Context, string) (ds.PoolConn, ds.ServerID, error) {
	return collectionPool{connection: p.connection}, "test", nil
}
func (collectionProvider) Release(ds.PoolConn, ds.ServerID) {}

func TestGeneratedGroupedEndpointContinuation(t *testing.T) {
	services.RegisterGeneratedServices()
	connection := &collectionConn{t: t}
	routes := []webapp.Route{}
	group := webapp.NewGroup("", &routes)
	registerGeneratedRoutes(&group)
	handler := webapp.MustBuildRouter(&webapp.AppContext{DB: collectionProvider{connection: connection}}, routes)
	request := func(params string) []int {
		t.Helper()
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		handler.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/cursor-items?params="+url.QueryEscape(params), nil))
		if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("%d: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
		var body struct {
			Rows []struct {
				Code int `json:"item_code"`
			} `json:"rows"`
			Agg struct {
				Total int `json:"tot_count"`
			} `json:"agg"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &body); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(body.Rows) != 2 || body.Agg.Total == 0 {
			t.Fatal(response.Body.String())
		}
		return []int{body.Rows[0].Code, body.Rows[1].Code}
	}
	first := request(`{"count":2,"sorter":[{"f":"priority","d":"d"},{"f":"item_code","d":"d"}]}`)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(first, []int{5, 4}) {
		t.Fatal(first)
	}
	connection.continuation = true
	next := request(`{"count":2,"sorter":[{"f":"priority","d":"d"},{"f":"item_code","d":"d"}],"where":{"or":[{"f":"priority","o":"l","v":20},{"and":[{"f":"priority","o":"e","v":20},{"f":"item_code","o":"l","v":4}]}]}}`)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(next, []int{3, 2}) || reflect.DeepEqual(first, next) {
		t.Fatal(first, next)
	}
	connection.continuation, connection.offset = false, true
	if page := request(`{"from":1,"count":2,"sorter":[{"f":"priority","d":"d"},{"f":"item_code","d":"d"}]}`); !reflect.DeepEqual(page, []int{4, 3}) {
		t.Fatal(page)
	}
	if connection.queries != 6 {
		t.Fatal("data and aggregate query count:", connection.queries)
	}
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/cursor-items?where="+url.QueryEscape(`{"and":[]}`), nil))
	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || connection.queries != 6 {
		t.Fatal(response.Code, connection.queries)
	}
}
